agent_order: if failure: counterexample_analysis -> repair -> tool_execution repeat

spec_extraction.name: spec_extraction
spec_extraction.description: Extracts constants, assumptions, guarantees, safety properties, and uncertainties from selected spec excerpt.

code_understanding.name: code_understanding
code_understanding.description: Summarizes selected implementation code: inputs, outputs, loops, array accesses, helpers, risks, uncertainties.

property_discovery.name: property_discovery
property_discovery.description: Combines spec and code summaries to propose candidate formal properties.

artifact_generation.name: artifact_generation
artifact_generation.description: Generates candidate CBMC harnesses, assumptions, assertions, and notes.

critic_review.name: critic_review
critic_review.description: Reviews generated artifact for unsupported assumptions, weak/strong assertions, wrong constants, trivial proofs, and edge cases.

tool_execution.name: tool_execution
tool_execution.description: Runs CBMC or selected formal tool and stores output/status.

counterexample_analysis.name: counterexample_analysis
counterexample_analysis.description: Explains failed CBMC/tool result and classifies failure source.

repair.name: repair
repair.description: Repairs/refines candidate artifact based on critic and counterexample analysis.

experiment_logger.name: experiment_logger
experiment_logger.description: Optional external logger finalization. Internal JSONL logging always runs even if this script does not exist.

evaluation_reporter.name: evaluation_reporter
evaluation_reporter.description: Generates final evaluation report and table from the run folder.

positioning.claim: Agents generate candidate formal-verification artifacts and evidence for evaluation.
positioning.non_claim: The workflow does not claim to fully prove ML-KEM automatically.
positioning.authority: CBMC/formal tools and human researcher remain final correctness authority.
